nodes.statement: Fix independently admitted actual token-windows P,Q, bearer/time binding, one common declared complete signature K*, complete actual structures, and any transported parameters.
nodes.scope: One same-signature comparison; finite models, projections, reports and external names remain different sorts.

nodes.statement: Distinguish a selected current projection, a history-expanded projection and the declared complete actual K*-isomorphism type; equality at one level is never silently promoted to another.
nodes.scope: Exactly R192:DOMAIN and explicitly declared projections.

nodes.statement: An admissible candidate q is internal/extensional to K*, invariant under sort-preserving K*-isomorphism, uses only grounded relations and fixed or transported parameters, and excludes desired phenomenal names, reports, analyst source labels and outcome-selected features.
nodes.scope: Candidate-selection discipline on R192:DOMAIN; admissibility does not establish correct phenomenal meaning.

nodes.statement: If D_K*(P) and D_K*(Q) are sort-preserving isomorphic, every admissible q agrees; under A:C1 their complete experiential types agree as well.
nodes.scope: Complete K*-twins only, with transported parameters; no conclusion from partial behavioral or model equality.

nodes.statement: Equal selected projection defeats only candidate bridges factoring through that projection and does not entail complete-organizational equality.
nodes.scope: One fixed projection pi and q=g∘pi on the R192 comparison domain.

nodes.statement: Actual prior occurrence, same-lineage continuation and present use may separate a current-projection twin after history expansion, but the new coordinate is not thereby familiar mineness or endorsement.
nodes.scope: Actual-history application satisfying the R173 interface; copied values are excluded as occurrence substitutes.

nodes.statement: Swapping external reflex/endorsement labels or reports on one unchanged complete structure changes no admissible internal predicate.
nodes.scope: Only labels not installed as K* relations; actual report-production changes require a new organization comparison.

nodes.statement: Structural admissibility and sparse external target labels need not select a unique B_fam; target naming remains a separate independently constrained bridge problem.
nodes.scope: Finite witness plus the existing semantic-residual boundary; no global impossibility claim.

nodes.statement: Future twin arguments must declare their signature level, seek new organization only for projection twins, treat complete-twin experiential difference as a C1 challenge, and keep actual route use, diagnostic evidence and named phenomenal interpretation separate.
nodes.scope: UCT research protocol; not a consciousness test or basal-experience gate.

rules.statement: Apply isomorphism preservation to one complete K* comparison and C1 only after actual/completeness premises.
rules.binding: P,Q,K*, h, parameters and q are fixed throughout; complete and projected structures are not interchanged.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No alternative route; all premises are simultaneous.

rules.statement: Restrict the existing fiber criterion to one declared selected projection.
rules.binding: The projection, target domain, bearer/time assignments and factorizing bridge are common.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Projection and complete-signature routes are distinct claims, not disjunctive proofs.

rules.statement: Expand a current projection only with actual R173-style occurrence, lineage, continuation and current-use relations.
rules.binding: All history facts concern the same bearer lineage, target and current consumer; copied memory is not an occurrence.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Actual history and copied value are rival cases, not interchangeable premises.

rules.statement: Vary only an excluded external label while retaining the complete structure.
rules.binding: The complete state and admissible q remain fixed; only the noninstalled annotation varies.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A changed report-producing mechanism is outside this label-only case.

rules.statement: Combine selector admissibility with the existing naming residual and an exact sparse-label witness.
rules.binding: The internal candidate set and external target labels remain separately typed on one fixed domain.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: More independent target constraints may narrow the candidate set; they are not silently supplied.

rules.statement: Use the four jointly scoped results to choose the next research operation without adding a basal-experience gate.
rules.binding: Each comparison retains its own fixed bearer/time/signature and evidence grade; no finite witness is promoted to actual installation.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Projection-twin and complete-twin branches are mutually exclusive diagnoses of one declared comparison.

context_links.statement: R192 applies the existing representation-fiber theorem to reflex/endorsement projections.
Internal coordinate transport does not select the external familiar-mineness name.
History expansion can distinguish structure while B_fam remains open.
No selector, history relation, bridge identification or report is required for basal nonempty experience.
